actionable_recommendations: Perform a Google search of your nonprofit to see what potential funders will find.
Ensure your website is current and clear to instill confidence in funders.
Use a Candid profile that is up to date and accurate.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Information on what funders specifically look for when searching for nonprofits.
Details about the impact of outdated or unclear websites on funding credibility.
Statements about the effects of inconsistent information across different platforms.
major_ideas: Funders evaluate nonprofits based on online visibility before engaging.
First impressions via online search can influence funders' decisions.
Credibility can be built without a large budget or staff.
prerequisites: Understanding the importance of online presence for nonprofits.
Familiarity with creating and maintaining a Candid profile.
proposed_workflow: Conduct a trust test by Googling your nonprofit.
Assess and update website content accordingly.
Check social media and fundraising materials for consistency.
title: Before a Funder Gives You Money, They Check THIS
